name: Lunchtime reversal of the morning trend
hypothesis: Between 11:30 and 13:30, fade a morning trend of more than 0.7% when a reversal bar closes back through the 20-bar EMA.

definition.name: Lunchtime reversal of the morning trend

entry.short: time_between("11:30", "13:30") and close / session().open - 1 > 0.007 and cross_below(close, ema(close,20))
entry.long: time_between("11:30", "13:30") and close / session().open - 1 < -0.007 and cross_above(close, ema(close,20))
